movie.title: Triple Decker
movie.overview: Over the course of one bizarre day, a couple with a dangerous plan and a stranger with her own agenda find their lives colliding in the most unexpected ways. As secrets simmer beneath the surface, everything quickly spirals into a wild mix of chaos, dark humor, and perfectly timed misfortune—where every move only makes things worse.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Over the course of a single chaotic day, a couple executing a dangerous plan collides with a mysterious stranger, triggering a dark-comedy spiral of secrets, bad decisions, and escalating misfortune.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: A couple embarking on a high-stakes, dangerous plot finds their meticulous plan disrupted when their path crosses with an enigmatic stranger pursuing her own secret agenda. Over twenty-four bizarre hours, hidden truths simmer to the surface and spark a chain reaction of absurd, dark-comedy mishaps. As every desperate attempt to regain control backfires, the trio is swept into a wild storm of escalating chaos. Ultimately, their intersecting lives prove that when bad luck and bad choices collide, things can always get worse.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: The story unfolds over twenty-four unpredictable hours, centering on a couple determined to pull off a risky, dangerous scheme. Their carefully laid plans take an unexpected turn when they cross paths with a mysterious stranger who carries a hidden agenda of her own. As the three are forced to navigate the day together, underlying tensions and long-buried secrets begin to bubble to the surface. What starts as a series of awkward encounters rapidly devolves into a web of dark humor, bizarre coincidences, and catastrophic missteps. Every calculated move made by the couple only serves to deepen their predicament and worsen their odds. Meanwhile, the stranger's true intentions add another layer of volatility to an already explosive situation. As the day progresses, the line between victim and instigator blurs amidst the mounting tension and absurd misfortunes. Tensions peak in a thrilling climax where hidden motives collide head-on with fate. Ultimately, the trio is forced to confront the hilarious, chaotic consequences of a day where everything that could go wrong inevitably does.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Triple Decker is a darkly comedic thriller that follows a couple on the verge of executing a dangerous plot, only to have their day derailed by an unexpected third party with a secret agenda. Set entirely over the span of one frantic day, the narrative weaves together tension, sharp humor, and a series of spiraling misfortunes. As secrets are uncovered and desperate choices are made, the story explores the unpredictable domino effect of human error and bad timing. The film delivers a suspenseful, edge-of-your-seat journey through a maze of chaos where every attempt to fix a mistake only pushes the characters deeper into trouble.

story_structure.climax: All competing agendas, secrets, and terrible decisions converge into a chaotic, high-stakes turning point where control is completely lost and the situation reaches peak absurdity.
story_structure.conflict: The paths of the couple and the stranger unexpectedly collide, igniting a series of misunderstandings and dark complications that disrupt their original motives.
story_structure.resolution: In the aftermath of the day's wild madness, the dust settles, leaving the characters to reckon with the unexpected consequences of their colliding lives.
story_structure.introduction: A couple harboring a dangerous plan and an unpredictable stranger go about their day, each pursuing their own hidden agendas as tension quietly builds beneath the surface.
story_structure.risingAction: As secrets are gradually exposed, every attempt to manage the growing mess triggers a domino effect of bizarre mishaps, dark humor, and rapidly compounding chaos.
